jobs.title: Head of Product Marketing (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Stellenbeschreibung Du bist die Brücke zwischen unserer Produktentwicklung und einem der stärksten Performance-Marketing-Teams im europäischen D2C: Jeder Schuh verlässt bei dir die Entwicklung mit fertiger Launch-Story, belegten Aussagen und Creative-Angles. Und du baust den Insight-Motor auf, der aus Millionen Ad-Kommentaren und einem eigenen Kunden-Panel die Produkt-Briefs von morgen macht. Bei Pammys ist Product Marketing keine Übersetzungs-Abteilung — es sitzt im Produktbereich und entscheidet, welches Produkt für welche Nische gebaut wird. 

 Deine Aufgaben Du planst und steuerst unsere Produktlaunches: Timing, Positionierung, Abstimmung mit Performance, Creator-Team, CRM und Shop
 Du baust unsere Insights-Funktion auf: ein eigenes Kunden-Panel, Segmentierung, qualitative Interviews — und die systematische Auswertung von Community- und Anzeigen-Feedback
 Du übersetzt Erkenntnisse in Produkt-Briefs: Passform- und Komfort-Themen, Wünsche, nächste Modell-Ideen — direkt in die Produktentwicklung und zum Founder
 Du lieferst Botschaft und Angle-Hypothesen an das Creative-Team — Testergebnisse aus den Kampagnen fließen zurück in deinen Insight-Kreislauf
 Du entwickelst pro Produkt die Kernbotschaft: welches Problem es löst, für wen, warum jetzt – und briefst damit Creative-Team und Creator
 Du überlegst dir, was für USP das neue Produkt haben soll, damit es perfekt in Social Media passt und eine spezielle Nische perfekt bedient  
 Du wertest Kundenfeedback systematisch aus (Surveys, Reviews, Retourengründe) und bringst die Erkenntnisse ins Produktteam und in die Kampagnen
 Du konzipierst Angebote und Bundles mit und rechnest sie durch – auf Deckungsbeitrag, nicht nur auf Conversion
 Du überlegst dir, was für USP das neue Produkt haben soll, damit es perfekt in Social Media passt und eine spezielle Nische perfekt bedient  
 

 Dein Profil 4+ Jahre Erfahrung in Product Marketing, Brand Management oder Growth – idealerweise bei einer D2C-Brand oder im E-Commerce
 Du hast schon Produktlaunches verantwortet und kannst konkret sagen, was dabei rausgekommen ist
 Du schreibst selbst: Positionierungen, Briefings, Landingpage-Copy. Klar und ohne Floskeln
 Du arbeitest mit Zahlen: Conversion, Deckungsbeitrag, Sell-Through sagen dir etwas
 Du verstehst, wie Performance-Creative funktioniert und was ein Hook ist 
 Sehr gutes Deutsch, gutes Englisch
 

 Deine Vorteile bei Pammys Maximaler Einfluss: Product Marketing sitzt bei uns direkt an der Schnittstelle von Produkt, Growth und Founder-Team. Deine Erkenntnisse beeinflussen unmittelbar, welche Produkte wir als Nächstes entwickeln.
 Keine Marketing-Theorie: Du arbeitest mit echten Kunden, echten Kaufdaten und sehr großen Mengen an Performance- und Creative-Daten und siehst unmittelbar, welche Entscheidungen funktionieren.
 Extrem schnelle Feedback-Loops: Produkt, Performance Marketing, Creative, CRM und E-Commerce arbeiten eng zusammen. Was du entwickelst, landet nicht Monate später in einer Präsentation, sondern wird getestet.
 Aufbau statt Verwaltung: Du übernimmst keine fertige Product-Marketing-Struktur, sondern kannst Prozesse, Customer-Insights-Systeme und Launch-Mechaniken selbst aufbauen und prägen.
 Große Reichweite: Deine Arbeit beeinflusst Produkte und Kampagnen für eine Brand mit bereits über 1 Million Kundinnen und Kunden.
 Direkter Austausch mit den Foundern: Kurze Entscheidungswege, hohe Geschwindigkeit und direkter Zugang zu den Personen, die Produkt- und Unternehmensstrategie verantworten.
 Starkes Performance-Marketing-Umfeld: Du arbeitest eng mit einem datengetriebenen Performance- und Creative-Team zusammen und kannst Produktmarketing unmittelbar mit realem Marktfeedback verbinden.
 Großer Gestaltungsspielraum: Wir wollen nicht, dass du bestehende Prozesse nur ausführst. Wir erwarten, dass du sie hinterfragst und besser machst.
 Steile Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Pammys wächst weiter in neue Produkte, Kategorien und Märkte. Dein Verantwortungsbereich kann mit diesem Wachstum deutlich größer werden.
 Unternehmerische Kultur: Wir suchen Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Entscheidungen treffen und Ergebnisse liefern wollen.

jobs.title: Head of Product Development & Engineering (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Stellenbeschreibung Wir machen wenige Modelle in großen Stückzahlen — jeder Millimeter am Leisten, im Fußbett und in der Konstruktion multipliziert sich hunderttausendfach. Aus diesem Grund muss der Schuh perfekt sitzen. Du baust Produkte nach der Pammys Bibel. Bisher entwickeln wir eng mit Partnern. Jetzt bauen wir die technische Produktentwicklung im eigenen Haus auf: eigene Leisten- und Passform-Standards, eigene Komfort-Technologien, ein eigenes Entwicklungsteam. 

 Deine Aufgaben Du verantwortest den kompletten Entwicklungsprozess: Brief → Tech-Pack → Proto-Runden → Sales Samples → Sealed Sample → Serienanlauf (Tooling-Trials, PPS, TOP). Jedes technische Gate auf diesem Weg liegt bei dir — inklusive der Freigabe, mit der ein Modell in Serie geht.
 Du baust dein Team auf und führst es: Footwear Development, Leisten & Passform (Last & Fit), Tooling, Commercialisation und Materials — in der Reihenfolge, die das Wachstum verlangt.

jobs.description:
About Us STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionising the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop, and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective — providing operators with a decisive edge in contested environments. 
 We are focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems — not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe, today. 

 About the team At the heart of our robotic platforms are robust sensor networks and reliable operating systems. As a Robotics Product Owner, you will be the vital link between high-level system requirements and daily engineering execution. 

 Your mission You will guide a cross-functional team of hardware and software engineers through a rapidly growing portfolio of projects. By taking inputs from system engineers and program managers, you will ensure the team always has clear, actionable, and prioritized work, while keeping the broader organization informed of our technical capabilities. 

 Responsibilities Translate Needs:  Work closely with system engineers and program managers to break down complex system requirements into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria for the engineering team. 

 Push the Backlog:  Regularly align with the team lead to manage and prioritize the team's backlog across the hardware and software stack, balancing long-term foundational architecture with immediate project milestones. 

 Drive Execution:  Facilitate daily alignment across the team—from hardware engineers working on optics and supplier specs, to software engineers building out embedded systems and sensor overlays—to unblock work and keep sprints moving smoothly. 

 Document Capabilities:  Maintain clear, accessible, and up-to-date documentation of our technical capabilities, system resources, and sprint outcomes so stakeholders always know what the team can deliver. 

 Evaluate & Accept Work:  Review completed engineering work against requirements, navigating collaborative trade-offs when friction arises between hardware constraints, embedded software performance, and project timelines. 

 

 Qualifications Experience:  3+ years of experience as a Technical Product Manager, or similar roles, specifically working on hardware-software integrated products, robotics, IoT, or complex technical platforms. 

 Technical Literacy:  You are comfortable reviewing technical structures, navigating code repositories on GitLab, and collaborating effectively with software engineers. 

 Systems Thinking:  A solid understanding of the robotics and embedded tech stack. You should feel comfortable discussing sensor calibration, edge computing (like Jetson platforms), driver integration, and overall system architecture. 

 Communication:  Exceptional ability to communicate complex concepts clearly, acting as the bridge between deeply technical engineers and higher-level program managers. 

 

 Nice to have Familiarity with sensor hardware lifecycles and optics. 

 Experience with embedded Linux, Jetson carrier boards, or base image configuration. 

 Experience with Agile frameworks in a hardware context. 

 Previous experience working in the defense, aerospace, or autonomous vehicle sectors. 
 

 We know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds. If you don't have these exact qualifications but feel you could succeed in this role, please apply anyway.

About Scale AI

Scale AI accelerates the development and deployment of AI, from the high-quality training data and evaluation services that power the world's leading AI labs, to full-stack AI applications built for Enterprise, U.S. Public Sector, and Global Public Sector customers. We don't just hand over a model; we find the highest-value use case, build the system around it, and own the outcome, whether that's an agent supporting mission planning for the Department of Defense, a sovereign AI platform for a government ministry, or an agentic workflow inside a Fortune 500 enterprise. Our platform powers breakthroughs at the frontier of AI, and great design is how we make that power accessible, intuitive, and trusted by the teams who rely on it every day.

The Role

We're looking for a product design leader to lead and grow our enterprise team.

What You'll Do

  • Set the direction for Enterprise design. Define what exceptional design looks like for Scale's Applications customers making high-stakes decisions and for the expert contributors powering the platform. Translate the broader design vision into a clear, motivating direction for your team.

  • Contribute to the design system. Help shape and adopt Scale's shared design system, championing consistent component use and contributing patterns back so a distributed team can build coherently at speed.
  • Ground the team in user needs. Build the research habits and cadences that keep your team's decisions rooted in what enterprise customers and users actually need, and advocate for that discipline with your Product and Engineering partners.
  • Shape Scale's approach to human-agent interaction. Scale's core value is human-in-the-loop AI, and the interface is where trust is built or lost. Help define the interaction patterns for how enterprise users work alongside AI agents, and contribute to Scale's growing point of view on this emerging space.

Who you are

  • 3+ years managing product design teams
  • Proven track record of simplifying data-dense, power-user workflows into elegant solutions for B2B and beyond
  • Deeply customer-centric, with a track record of grounding design decisions in real user needs and business impact

  • Experience designing for agentic platforms, and excited to shape the future of interaction patterns for AI and human-in-the-loop systems

  • Excellent communicator. You can present to a leaders and a front-line PM and make both feel heard

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Data APIs)
jobs.description:
About 9fin 
 9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.
 Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.
 Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.
 We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.
 
 The Opportunity 
  
 9fin has built one of the most comprehensive datasets in credit and debt markets: news, financials, cap tables, instrument data, legal documents, and ESG analysis. Today, most clients access that data through 9fin.com . But a large and growing segment of the market wants to consume our data programmatically to power firm-level workflows at scale: a negative news signal triggers an automated credit review, updated financials trigger a portfolio rebalance, a covenant keyword triggers a sanctions flag.
  
 These buyers (quant desks, data engineering teams, systematic investors, risk and compliance functions) will never log into a web application. They need APIs, data feeds, and cloud-native delivery through platforms like Snowflake. At comparable financial data providers, this distribution channel represents 20-30% of total revenue. 9fin is at the beginning of this journey.
  
 The challenge is to turn 9fin's integrated dataset into a portfolio of standalone data products with a coherent commercial strategy. You will define how the data gets packaged (what goes together, what stands alone, how it's tiered and priced), the order in which products go to market, and the commercial models that fit each buyer segment: quant desks, data engineering teams, risk and compliance functions, and systematic investors. You will work in lockstep with the Head of Pre-Sales, who owns technical validation and deal execution, to ensure that what you build maps to how these buyers actually evaluate and procure data. The first candidates pan news content, financials and cap tables, instrument data, and legal data (complex, high-value, and genuinely unsolved at the data representation layer).
  
 You will work cross-functionally across our platform teams, analytics engineering, and the domain squads that own the underlying datasets. You will also work closely with Sales to support a fundamentally different GTM motion: solution-selling with partner clients, joint POCs, multi-stakeholder deals, and usage-based commercial models rather than seat-based subscriptions.
  
 This is a 0-to-1 build. If you have built API or data products before and want to do it again in a market where the opportunity is wide open, this is it.
  
  
 What You'll Do 
  
 Product Strategy & Execution 
 Define the product vision and strategy for 9fin's external data distribution: APIs, data shares, and future delivery mechanisms (cloud sync, pub/sub).

 Own the data catalogue decisions: which datasets to expose, in what format, through which channels, and in what order, balancing client demand, data readiness, and commercial potential

 Design the developer experience end-to-end: API design, documentation, developer portal, sandbox/playground, error handling, rate limiting, and versioning

 Work with analytics engineering and domain teams to define schemas, data models, and transformation logic that make 9fin's data consumable and valuable outside the application

 Use a partner model to validate early: select and work closely with 1-2 clients during development to co-develop and prove out each data product before broader launch

 Shape the commercial model for API products: packaging, tiering, usage-based pricing, distribution controls, and entitlement structures that capture the value of programmatic data access

  
 Data Quality, Infrastructure & Compliance 
  
 Partner with the Head of Analytics to ensure data products meet the reliability, freshness, and accuracy standards that enterprise clients building automated systems expect

 Define SLAs for data delivery (latency, uptime, completeness) and build the monitoring and metering infrastructure to back them up

 Own the entitlements and access control layer: ensuring the right clients can access the right data under the right contractual terms, with appropriate usage limits and controls

 Work with Legal to define data usage policies, including restrictions on redistribution, AI training and model embedding, and onward use, protecting 9fin's data IP while enabling legitimate client workflows

 Estab

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Giftcard)
jobs.description:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

 We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

 Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

 
 
 About This Role: 

 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across France, Germany, and Spain.

 This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio.

 We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding.

 
 Our Benefits: 

 At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

 
 A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.

 A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.

 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.

 A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.

 Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.

 Mental health coaching to support your well-being.

 Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.

 The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.

 A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

 
 *These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location. 

 
 Responsibilities: 

 In this role, you will:

 
 Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience.

 Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance.

 Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis.

 Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension.

 Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet.

 Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction.

 Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform.

 
 
 Your Profile: 

 We're looking for someone with {explicit job content} experience, who is dedicated to creating exceptional user experiences and driving innovation.

 
 5+ years in product management , including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a leading tech company and/or a startup.

 A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit.

 Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features.

 Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring.

 Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, without formal authority over them.

 Excellent stakeholder management - able to influence and present confidently to senior/executive stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Product Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Statista , we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.
 Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.
 We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.
 Are you ready to join us?
 
 Requirements 
 Define and drive the product vision and roadmap for Statista's core platform capabilities, aligning technical investments with company-wide product and business goals

 Translate complex platform challenges into clear, prioritized requirements and work closely with engineering teams to deliver high-impact solutions across areas such as data infrastructure, APIs, and internal tooling

 Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation to accelerate platform development, improve developer experience, and unlock new capabilities for product teams

 Act as the bridge between technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring alignment on platform priorities, trade-offs, and delivery timelines

 Evaluate and shape integration strategies for emerging technologies, including AI/ML services, MCP protocols, and data pipeline architectures

 Continuously assess platform performance, scalability, and reliability, driving improvements through data-informed decision-making and close collaboration with engineering leadership

 
 Responsabilities 
 7+ years of experience in the tech industry with a strong understanding of product and engineering workflows, team dynamics, and modern software development practices

 At least 2 years of recent, hands-on experience in a heavily technical product domain such as platform engineering, data infrastructure, AI/ML, or API development

 Proven background in platform or technical product management; experience in data platforms or data engineering is a strong plus

 You actively integrate AI into your daily workflows and are continuously refining and expanding how you use AI-powered tools to increase your effectiveness

 Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate between deeply technical concepts and strategic business language

 Strong analytical mindset with a structured approach to prioritization, problem-solving, and stakeholder alignment

 You thrive in cross-functional environments and are comfortable navigating ambiguity, legacy systems, and evolving technical landscapes

 
 What we offer 
 In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:
 Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

 Hybrid work and flex-time

 International team and social events

 Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

 Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

 Career & training opportunities

 Attractive locations and modern offices

 Mental health support with OpenUp

 Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.

jobs.title: Product Management Director – Soft FM & Estates (UK)
jobs.description:
About SINGU 
 
 At SINGU , we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.
  
 Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide , supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started.
  
 Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus. 
  
 If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation. 
 
 About the Role 
 
 You'll own a significant slice of the SINGU product suite: space management and Soft FM services – cleaning standards, portering, and catering – used every day primarily across the UK healthcare market . Product-market fit is established and thousands of users depend on these products daily. What the portfolio needs now is strategic direction and taking them to their next level of growth.
 You'll do that through a team of four Product Managers who are domain experts in the products they run. This is a hands-on leadership role . You'll stay close to customer problems yourself, you'll raise the bar on how the team discovers and validates work, and you'll have real autonomy to decide what's worth building – and to prove it works.
 SINGU group grows both organically and through acquisition, and several of these products arrived with the companies that built them. You'll shape the strategy for bringing them into one coherent ecosystem and lead your team through that change. If you enjoy taking a set of good but separate products and making them add up to something bigger, that is the interesting part of this job.
 You'll partner closely with Sales, Engineering, and Product colleagues across the SINGU Group so your portfolio drives revenue and solves real problems across the European FM market. AI is a must-have lever in our industry rather than a talking point: you'll be applying it where it measurably improves how our customers run their estates.
 This is a remote position with periodic travel to London and Kraków – roughly every two to four weeks.
 
 Role Scope 
 
 People Leadership & Team Development: 
 Manage and develop the Product Managers within the product team.

 Own the full management lifecycle: hiring, onboarding, mentorship, feedback, coaching, performance evaluations, promotions, and exits .

 Foster a high-performing product culture based on customer empathy, data-driven decision-making, and outcome orientation.

 Manage staffing and focus areas across the suite, reallocating product resources where needed to balance discovery workload and meet strategic priorities.

 Lead the team through change – new ways of working, a shifting portfolio, and product consolidation – bringing people with you rather than around them.

 
 Product Discovery & Strategy: 
 Define and maintain product roadmaps aligned with business objectives, customer needs, and market trends.

 Decide where to invest and where to hold : set a clear, defensible position on which initiatives scale and communicate it across the business.

 Build strong alignment with the Sales team to ensure product discovery and roadmap priorities actively unblock deals and support revenue growth.

 Identify and resolve ambiguities, dependencies, and competing priorities that impact discovery quality and speed.

 
 Product Management Best Practices & Standards: 
 Promote modern product practices, including continuous discovery, outcome-based roadmapping, and hypothesis-driven development .

 Ensure product teams consistently validate assumptions through user research, experimentation, and data analysis .

 Drive improvements in requirements quality, stakeholder communication, prioritization frameworks, and release planning.

 Cooperate with the Chief Architect and Engineering Managers to ensure product decisions account for technical feasibility and platform constraints.

 Drive the adoption of AI-powered tools and analytics to improve product insights, customer understanding, and decision-making quality.

 
 Collaboration & Cross-Company Coordination: 
 Coordinate with commercial and customer-facing teams to align product strategy with go-to-market plans and revenue goals for the portfolio.

 Responsibilities:

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About MUBI
 MUBI is a global streaming service, production company and film distributor dedicated to elevating great cinema. To make this possible, we create, curate, acquire and champion visionary films, bringing them to audiences all over the world. We have a team of brilliant, dedicated and passionate people to help bring our mission to life. From London to New York, Istanbul to Paris, and Berlin to Mexico - we work together to realize MUBI’s vision.
 That’s where you come in! Join our global team and help us make great cinema accessible to everyone, everywhere.
 
 About the role

 This is a senior, hands-on product role for someone who wants to own a meaningful slice of the MUBI product end-to-end, and is at their best when the problem is still ambiguous.

 You’ll own the Audience & Platform Expansion domain - a critical product surface for our next phase of growth. In this role, you will be responsible for building the scalable foundation to drive global subscriber acquisition and pioneer our tiered premium offerings. You’ll own its strategy, its roadmap and its delivery, from a high-level business goal all the way to a shipped, measured feature. The hardest product problems at MUBI cross team and time-zone boundaries, and break down without someone holding the whole picture; this role exists to be that person for one of these domains.

 Reporting to our Senior Product Director, this is a senior, individual contributor role. You'll lead through clarity and influence rather than headcount - aligning engineering, design and data scientists around a vision they actually believe in, and mentoring/coaching other, more junior PMs as you go. We care about craft, in the films we champion and in the products we build, so the bar is product excellence and real user impact, not shipping for its own sake.

 We work hybrid-remote where we require 3 office days in Soho, London (if you're in commutable distance from London). Our core days are Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday, with the flexibility to use our offices on the remaining two days if you wish.
 
 Where you'll have impact

 You'll own a product surface that leadership relies on, translating ambiguous, evolving priorities into a roadmap teams can execute against - and giving the business a crisp, honest read on what's working, what isn't, and what needs a decision. As you build credibility through delivery, you'll set the standard for how product strategy is articulated and defended at MUBI. Concretely, you'll:
 Translate business goals into clear, actionable product roadmaps, and own the sub-strategy for a specific MUBI area (e.g. onboarding, content/catalogue discovery, monetization, or viewer experience).

 Guide technical products through the entire lifecycle - from conception, through development, into launch - and iterate after.

 Partner directly with Engineering, UX/UI Design, Data Science, Marketing, Business Development and Legal to define product requirements and resolve trade-offs.

 Establish the KPIs and OKRs for your area, and use data-backed insight to iterate quickly and demonstrate measurable impact.

 Pitch roadmaps to senior leadership to guide resource allocation, and align engineering, design and analytics teams without relying on direct hierarchy.

 Write narrative strategy memos and present complex visions clearly - to senior leadership and engineering teams alike.

 Mentor other team members and raise the bar for product thinking around you.

 You've spent significant time shipping complex technical products end to end, and you're happiest owning a problem from the messy, ambiguous start rather than picking up a tidy backlog. You bring structure where there is none - a clear strategy, sharp prioritisation, honest measurement - without becoming a source of process for its own sake.

 You're technically fluent enough to hold your own with strong engineers: you can translate an ML model, a streaming architecture or a latency constraint into a business trade-off a stakeholder can act on, and tell a real architectural limit from a convenient one.

 You're an excellent communicator who can flex between an engineer and an executive in the same hour, equally comfortable writing a strategy memo and defending it in a leadership review.

 You lead through influence - aligning people across functions, regions and time zones around work they want to do.

About Tandem Tandem is the leading global language learning community, with over 35 million members from all around the world practicing languages together.  Spec and land a small number of features with design and engineering; you are accountable for the outcome, not the ticket. 

 Share results in a way the rest of Tandem can act on. 

 

 You are the right fit for the role if you: Have 3+ years of product management experience, including consumer mobile apps at scale.

 Are a clear communicator and a strong collaborator, with excellent written and spoken English. 

 Care about simple, intuitive user experiences and can work closely with design to get there. 

 Like hard problems and stay with them until they are solved. 

 Use AI in your own work to move faster, and are thoughtful about where it belongs in product operations.

Passion for languages:

 Work inside the workflow. Spend real time with investigators, research nurses and coordinators, referring clinicians, patients, sponsor teams and CRO operators. Observe the work, not the meeting about the work.

 Make pragmatic integration and data calls across EHR/EMR, CTMS, EDC, eConsent, ePRO, trial registries, identity and communications systems.

 You’d have taken one sponsor’s protocol, turned its inclusion and exclusion criteria into a working pre-screening prototype, then watched a research nurse try to break it.

(Fully remote, async-first, DevTools SaaS, 40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3) 
 The best developers don't wait for a customer to tell them something's broken.
 They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist. We give developers and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: monitoring defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, versioned and reviewed like everything else they ship. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.
 Thousands of them, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password, build with us. Now we need a PM who wants to take that further, in a market being rewritten in real time.
 Here's the thing about 2026: AI agents and coding assistants are shipping more software, faster, than any team could review by hand, and more of it is breaking in ways nobody has seen before. LLM-backed features fail probabilistically. Agents take actions no runbook anticipated. "Is my app healthy?" is becoming an unanswerable question for a whole generation of AI-native software. Nobody has really figured out what reliability means for this kind of software yet. That's the problem you'd own.
 
 What you'll do
 As a Product Manager, you will be responsible for empowering developers and designers to solve customer problems. You will work directly with our SVP Product Engineering Daniel .
 You will:
 Shape company and product strategy alongside our SVP of Product Engineering. It's a genuine partnership: you'll develop the vision for where Checkly goes next, decide where we play in the AI testing, monitoring, and observability landscape and where we don't, and turn that into a direction. You build the strategy with us, not execute someone else's.

 Shape Checkly's point of view on reliability in an AI-native world: how teams monitor AI-generated code, agent-driven workflows, and LLM-backed features

 Lead initiatives across Product Engineering, Sales and Marketing, and represent Checkly directly to customers and in developer communities.

 Live in the product and the problem. Empathy for DevOps, SRE and Platform Engineering isn't a line item. It's the job.

 You ship with AI where it helps and know when not to. You don't just talk about it.

 
 What you should have
 You've built software before this. You're an ex-engineer, ex-founder, or ex-solutions engineer who has written real code and shipped real things, and now you want to own the product. This one's non-negotiable: you should be able to reason about APIs, MCPs, CLIs, and how systems fit together without a translator.

 You've worked in a startup, not just a big company. You're comfortable with ambiguity, small teams, and owning outcomes end to end. You don't need a big-company machine around you to be effective.

 You've built technical products, ideally developer tools. Adjacent technical products count. Experience in monitoring or observability is a nice-to-have, not a requirement.

 New to the PM title? That's fine. If you're coming from a founding or solutions-engineering seat and want to go all-in on product, we want to hear from you.

 You're technical enough to be dangerous with AI tooling. You can prototype in code, throw together a mock, or pressure-test technical viability yourself when it moves things forward.

 FULLY remote role, within the UTC-3 to UTC+3 time zones. Need to be able to travel to (other) European countries without having to wait for a visa appointment.

 
 What you will hate about us
 We would rather tell you now than have you find out in month two.
 We use AI for everything, and we mean everything. AI skepticism is not a thing here. If you have the slightest hesitation about working with AI every day, this is not the place for you, and that is completely fine.

 We write more than we talk. We are async-first, so a lot of decisions happen in documents and threads, not meetings. If you do your best thinking out loud in a room full of people, you will miss it here.

 We are lean, so you own the boring parts too. There is no PM ops layer to delegate the unglamorous work to. You will do strategy one hour and clean up a messy spec the next.

 We ship constantly and change our minds. Priorities move as we learn from customers. If you need long, stable planning cycles, this will feel chaotic.

 Customer signals come first, and most of the time they beat your gut. We build what customers actually want, not the clever thing we dreamed up. Earn it by making customers happy, and then there is room for the moonshots. If you want to lead with your own bold bets, you will find this frustrating.

 Transparent salary because your salary shouldn't be dictated by how good a negotiator you are. (more info below)

jobs.title: Product Owner - Communications Channels & AI
jobs.description:
Role: Product Owner – Communication Channels & AI

 Location: Manchester

 Hours: Monday-Friday 8:45am-5:15pm

 Package: £80k OTE 

 

 As Product Owner - Technical Products, your role is to own and continuously improve PHMG's Technical product portfolio, ensuring Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE deliver measurable client value, operational quality and long-term commercial growth. 

 You are accountable for translating client needs, technology capability, partner opportunities and commercial priorities into scalable products and service models that strengthen adoption, retention and PHMG's competitive position. 

 Through H2 2026, you will lead the evolution of the technical product portfolio by bringing together product performance, platform capability, roadmap execution, client outcomes, commercial discipline, operational readiness and cross-functional alignment into one coherent product improvement agenda. 

 

 Key Objectives 

 Core Accountability 

 
 Own the strategy, design and ongoing performance of Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE.

 Set a clear, prioritised roadmap that balances client value, technical feasibility, commercial return, operational capacity and partner dependency.

 Ensure Technical products are positioned, sold, onboarded, serviced and renewed in a way that delivers measurable value for clients.

 Define the product standards, service models and client journeys that CS and Technical Production can execute consistently.

 Bring clarity to build, buy and partner decisions so product direction is deliberate, commercially disciplined and scalable.

 
 

 Technical Product Strategy & Roadmap 

 
 Define the long-term direction for Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE, including the sequence of capability, integrations and service-model changes.

 Prioritise AI Receptionist growth across both horizontal capability and the vertical use cases where PHMG has the strongest right to win.

 Create a clear approach for CCE in the existing base, reducing under-utilisation and turning technical review, onboarding and value evidence into retention levers.

 Partner with the Creative Product Owner so the full product set feels coherent to clients and to the teams selling and servicing it.

 
 

 

 Client Experience, Adoption & Value Evidence 

 
 Define the client experience for Technical products across onboarding, configuration, in-life usage, renewal and offboarding.

 Clarify how clients access, configure and understand product value through the portal, including call flows, AI Receptionist behaviour, CCE setup and usage analytics.

 Ensure CS has the standards, data and language needed to evidence value, drive adoption and manage client expectations confidently.

 Identify where clients slow, stall or disengage, and build product or service-model interventions that protect retention.

 
 

 Commercial Performance & Partner Discipline 

 
 Own the commercial logic of the Technical portfolio, including pricing, CAC, cost-to-serve, gross margin, revenue performance and investment cases.

 Operationalise the GoTo resell model with clear pricing, service, process and margin controls while protecting the partner relationship.

 Use data to assess where Technical products create incremental value, where they cannibalise existing activity and where the model needs to change.

 Make active trade-offs between speed, quality, margin, client experience and platform investment.

 
 

 Operational Delivery & Launch Readiness 

 
 Work with Technical Production and Tech to define standards, SLAs, runbooks and support models for each product and release.

 Ensure new capabilities do not go live until operational readiness, client communications, CS briefings and support routes are clear.

 Create tight governance for launch decisions, technical dependencies, client escalations, recurring provisioning issues and partner constraints.

 Keep accountability clear between Product, Tech and Product Operations so issues are solved at the right level rather than absorbed by CS.

 
 

 Insight, Reporting & Continuous Improvement 

 
 Maintain a reliable view of product performance across adoption, usage, NPS, retention, revenue, margin, service issues and operational friction.

 Build structured feedback loops with CS, Client Insights, Sales, Tech and Technical Production to identify product problems worth solving.

 Turn recurring client or operational issues into permanent product, process, reporting or service-model improvements.

 Use performance data to make early decisions before product issues become retention, margin or client-experience risks.

jobs.title: Project Manager, Gaming Localization Production
jobs.description:
About the Role 
 We're looking for a Project Manager to own the day-to-day delivery of a large-scale localization program for a multinational gaming publisher. This customer ships localized content across dozens of titles, platforms and languages, and the program spans in-game text, marketing and UA content, cinematics and trailers, and supporting print and digital collateral.
 You'll act as a key operational point of contact for the account, coordinating linguists, DTP and video specialists, and internal stakeholders to hit release-critical deadlines. This is a hands-on delivery role for someone who has managed localization programs for a game publisher before and is comfortable owning complex, multi-workstream schedules under tight deadlines.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own end-to-end delivery of localization projects for the account, from initial quoting and scoping through scheduling, resourcing and budget tracking, to final delivery and invoicing, across multiple concurrent titles and languages.

 Manage transcreation and marketing localization workstreams, ensuring tone, intent and cultural nuance are preserved for user acquisition, marketing and in-game copy.

 Coordinate subtitling, voiceover (AI and human) and video localization for trailers, cinematics and other video assets, including timing, rendering, editing and final QC of localized video files.

 Oversee desktop publishing (DTP) workflows for localized packaging, manuals and marketing collateral, working with DTP specialists to maintain layout fidelity across languages.

 Run thorough linguistic and mechanical/functional QC on every project, tracking issues to resolution and feeding recurring themes back into style guides, glossaries and linguist onboarding.

 Act as the day-to-day customer contact for delivery matters, managing a smooth workflow from quoting through local market review to completion, surfacing risks early and running status/retrospective calls.

 Manage high-volume, high-stakes workstreams within the account, building strong customer relationships and driving overall customer satisfaction.

 Build and maintain project schedules and resourcing plans across Workfront, Google sheets, and JIRA.

 Manage content intake, review cycles and publishing workflows in coordination with the customer's content and web teams.

 Use LILT-proprietary AI localization tools and build/maintain customer-specific translation memories and termbases to maintain consistency and leverage across projects.

 Support vendor management, including onboarding and evaluating linguists and other specialist vendors for the account.

 Support other project managers on the account, sharing best practice on production workflows and quality standards.

 What You'll Bring 
 Proven experience as a project manager in the localization industry, with direct experience delivering programs for a game publisher or games customer.

 Hands-on experience managing transcreation, subtitling, DTP, video rendering/editing and linguistic/mechanical QC workflows concurrently across multiple languages.

 Strong working knowledge of AEM, Workfront and Jira (or directly comparable content, work-management and issue-tracking tools).

 Practical experience with AI localization tools and translation memory / terminology management.

 Confident user of Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides) for reporting, tracking and customer-facing documentation.

 Experience managing high-volume, high-stakes customer accounts, with excellent stakeholder management across internal teams, linguists and customer contacts.

 Comfort with budget tracking and vendor/linguist management as part of day-to-day delivery.

 Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple concurrent, deadline-driven workstreams.

 Clear, confident written and verbal communication in English.

 Nice to Have 
 Experience with additional localization or workflow platforms beyond those listed above.

 Familiarity with quality frameworks such as ISO 17100 or ISO 9001.

 Experience working with global, multi-time-zone teams.

 What We Offer 
 The opportunity to work on high-profile, high-visibility programs for a global brand.

 A remote-first, collaborative team culture spanning EMEA and beyond.

 Exposure to cutting-edge AI-powered localization technology.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management
jobs.description:
Reporting to the VP, Product for Diligent Market Intelligence, you will lead the strategy, roadmap and evolution of Stewardship Intelligence—one of DMI’s core data products. Stewardship Intelligence provides meeting, executive compensation, corporate governance and proxy-voting intelligence to institutional asset managers, stewardship and governance professionals, compensation advisers and consultants, and corporate issuers. 

You will lead both Product Management and Research. This is a domain-led role: substantial experience in stewardship, proxy voting, corporate governance, executive compensation, investor relations or a closely related capital-markets domain is required. You will translate customer and market needs into clear product priorities, improve how research is performed at scale, and ensure that Stewardship Intelligence remains trusted, timely and valuable to its users. 

Here’s a breakdown of what you’ll do 

  • Own and continuously refine the product vision, strategy, roadmap and prioritisation for the Stewardship Intelligence portfolio, covering meeting, executive compensation, corporate governance and proxy-voting intelligence. 
  • Lead, develop and organise the Product Management and Research teams, establishing clear priorities, effective ways of working (with an emphasis on AI integration where possible), strong collaboration and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Manager, Browser Control Platform
jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About this team and role:

This role owns the foundation that lets other software drive Firefox: the secure, reliable connection an outside tool or another team uses to act inside the browser, and the building blocks they call to do it. It enables the teams building on it — internal teams, outside AI tools — to create their own products on top. This role owns the shared layer and the strategy for it. It’s a hands-on, technical role in a fast-moving, greenfield space, so it’s as much strategy as execution.

The opportunity is broad: internal teams (Smart Window, New Products’ automated tools), outside AI tools and their users, and web developers. The three share much of the underlying technology, but each reaches its market in a different way. The mandate is to figure out what to go after, and in what order.

What you’ll do:
  • Own the shared foundation and the building blocks it gives other software, and make them reliable and secure.
  • Push the open standard (WebDriver BiDi) forward, and build Firefox-only advantages the standard won’t cover 
  • Design the safety controls: let a person approve actions, see when software is acting for them, and take back control. 
  • Define the strategy for any major third-party AI assistants people already use.
  • Serve internal teams (Smart Window, New Products) and outside tools through one shared layer. 
Measured on:

Adoption across teams and tools, volume of usage through the platform, and sustained reliability and security.

What you'll bring:
  • A product-minded engineer, or a very technical PM who can drive a technical product 
  • Developer-space experience, with the range to think about consumers and internal platforms
  • Comfortable setting strategy in ambiguity; own a technical contract other teams depend on
  • Strong instincts on security and trust. Nice to have: web standards, MCP, browser automation

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget

 Timely and High-Quality Delivery of Roadmap : Ensure the successful and timely delivery of the product roadmap by collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders. This includes: 
 Achieve on-time delivery of planned iterations and releases, meeting or exceeding project milestones. 

 Maintain a backlog of well-defined and prioritized user stories that align with customer needs and business goals. 

 Minimize scope changes and rework through effective communication and requirement validation.
 

 Stakeholder Alignment : Establish strong communication channels with stakeholders and ensure a shared understanding of product vision, progress, and timelines. This includes: 
 Build and maintain trust-based relationships with stakeholders by providing clear, structured, and consistent communication. 

 Proactively address stakeholder concerns and manage expectations to ensure alignment with the product roadmap.
 

 Data-informed decisions : Drive continuous improvement of the product through data analysis, user feedback, and iterative development cycles. This includes: 
 Monitor and analyze key product and team KPIs (e.g., conversion rates, user engagement) to identify opportunities for enhancement. 

 Utilize data insights to prioritize features and improvements that have the highest impact on user satisfaction and business goals. 

 Implement iterative development practices, adjusting priorities and features based on real-time feedback and changing market conditions.

 

 Workplace: 
 We are mainly looking for this role based in Germany, preferably at our headquarters in Berlin. We are a remote-first company, with teams around the Globe and our HQ office in Berlin, where the team often meets in the office. 
 
 Who you are: 
 At least 3+ years of professional experience as a Product Owner 

 Have user-centric thinking: Ability to empathize with users, understand their needs, and prioritize features based on their value and impact 

 Strong communicator: You possess verbal and written communication skills to effectively convey the product vision, requirements, and updates to both the development team and stakeholders 

 Know Agile Methodology: You are proficient in Agile methodologies (particularly Scrum) to manage iterative development, prioritize work, and respond to changing requirements. 

 Hands-on with user story writing: You are able to break down complex features into clear and concise user stories that capture user needs, acceptance criteria, and business value. 

 Technically savvy: You understand the technical aspects of the product domain, allowing effective translation of requirements into actionable tasks for the development team. 

 Data-driven decision mindset: Your skills in using data and analytics help you make informed decisions, monitor KPIs, and identify areas for product improvement. 

 Problem-Solving approach: You are able to identify and address challenges that arise during product development, find creative solutions, and make timely adjustments. 

 Adaptability: You are willing to embrace change and adapt to evolving user needs, market trends, and business priorities 

 As a plus: 
 Experience with B2C products is a plus.

 

 What you can expect: 
 You will join a fast-paced travel tech company and take on a rapidly growing industry 

 You will take on ownership and responsibility from day one and have a direct impact on the success of the company 

 We value agility! We’re constantly updating our tech stack and offer the best possible tools to ensure all of our in-house engineers, partners, and carriers benefit from cutting-edge, efficient solutions. 

 You will work with global companies. Our product attracts the biggest names in travel technology, such as Booking.com, and Google Maps, and national carriers like Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF. 

 You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support, and challenge

jobs.title: Senior Manager Project Finance (m/w/d) – BESS & Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Über uns

 Wir sind ju:niz Energy – seit mehr als einem Jahrzehnt Pionierin für netzdienliche Batteriegroßspeicher. Von der Projektentwicklung über Bau und Vermarktung bis zum langfristigen Betrieb verbinden wir alle entscheidenden Kompetenzen unter einem Dach. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden BESS-Plattformen Deutschlands aufzubauen und die Energiewende mit leistungsstarker Speicherinfrastruktur messbar voranzubringen.

 Ob ein Speicherprojekt gebaut werden kann, entscheidet sich nicht nur an Technologie und Genehmigung, sondern auch an einer robusten, bankfähigen Finanzierung. Als Senior Manager Project Finance verantwortest du eigenständig die Strukturierung, Verhandlung und den Abschluss von Fremdfinanzierungen für unsere Greenfield- und Akquisitionsprojekte. Du führst Finanzierungen hands-on vom ersten Bankkontakt bis zum Financial Close und verbindest Banken, Investoren, Berater sowie unsere internen Teams.

 Deine Aufgaben

 
 Du strukturierst, verhandelst und schließt Projektfinanzierungen für BESS-Anlagen eigenständig ab – von der Bankenansprache und dem Term Sheet bis zur Unterzeichnung und zum Financial Close.

 Conditions Precedent und Conditions Subsequent steuerst du ebenso verlässlich wie Kreditverträge, Sicherheiten Pakete und Intercreditor Agreements gemeinsam mit Banken und externen Rechtsberatern.

 Belastbare Bankbeziehungen baust du aktiv aus und koordinierst Lender Due Diligence, Datenräume, Q&A-Prozesse sowie Technical, Legal, Insurance und Model Advisors.

 Die Bankfähigkeit zentraler Projektverträge wie EPC, O&M, Netzanschluss, PPAs oder Tolling Agreements und Landpacht stellst du frühzeitig mit Legal, Development und Delivery sicher.

 Komplexe Projektfinanzierungsmodelle entwickelst und pflegst du eigenständig – inklusive CFADS, DSCR, LLCR, IRR, Equity Return, DebtSculpting sowie Base, Bank und Downside Cases.

 Nach dem Closing verantwortest du Fremdfinanzierungscontrolling, Covenant Monitoring, Reserve Accounts und Bankreporting und entwickelst bei Risiken passende Waiver-,Reprofiling- oder Reforecast-Maßnahmen.

 Akquisitions- und Investitionsentscheidungen unterstützt du mit Finanzierungsindikationen, Business Cases und FID-Analysen und wirkst an unserer langfristigen Finanzierungs- und Investitionsstrategie mit.

 
 Dein Profil

 
 Du hast ein wirtschaftswissenschaftliches oder vergleichbares Studium abgeschlossen und verfügst über fünf bis zehn Jahre Erfahrung in Project Finance, Infrastructure Finance oder Transaction Advisory für erneuerbare Energien.

 Mehrere non-recourse Projektfinanzierungen hast du nachweislich hands-on von der Term-Sheet-Phase bis zum Financial Close strukturiert und erfolgreich abgeschlossen.

 CFADS, DSCR, LLCR, Debt Sculpting, Covenants, Cash Sweeps, Reserve Accounts sowie CP- und CS-Management beherrschst du fachlich sicher.

 LMA-basierte Kreditverträge, Sicherheitenpakete und Intercreditor Agreements kannst du verhandlungssicher beurteilen und gemeinsam mit Rechtsberatern zum Abschluss führen.

 Excel nutzt du auf Expertenniveau und baust komplexe Projektfinanzierungsmodelle selbstständig auf; Szenario- und Sensitivitätsanalysen gehören zu deinem täglichen Handwerkszeug.

 Lender Due Diligence und externe Berater steuerst du souverän. Erfahrung mit BESS-Revenue-Streams, dem deutschen Regulierungsrahmen sowie M&A- oder Co-Investment-Strukturen ist ein starkes Plus.

 Du verbindest Ownership, Pragmatismus und Verhandlungsstärke mit sehr gutem Deutsch und Englisch auf Verhandlungsniveau. Für die enge Zusammenarbeit bist du regelmäßig an unserem Standort in Aschheim bei München präsent.

 
 Warum wir?

 
 Direkter Einfluss darauf, welche großen Batteriespeicherprojekte in Deutschland finanziert und gebaut werden.

 End-to-End-Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Finanzierungen mit echter Entscheidungs- und Gestaltungsfreiheit.

 Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Management, Banken, Investoren und unserem Shareholder EQT.

 Ein ambitioniertes Wachstumsumfeld mit dem Ziel, bis 2030 1,5 GW in Betrieb zu bringen und zu den Top 3 in Deutschland zu gehören.

 Ein attraktives Vergütungspaket aus Fixgehalt und Bonus sowie flexible Zusammenarbeit mit regelmäßigem persönlichem Austausch.

 
 Kontakt

 Bewirb dich jetzt – auch wenn dein Lebenslauf nicht alle Punkte erfüllt. Entscheidend sind Motivation, Potenzial und dein Wille, die Energiewende aktiv mitzugestalten.

 Wir freuen uns ausdrücklich über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Erfahrungen. Gemeinsam schaffen wir ein Umfeld, in dem jeder sein volles Potenzial entfalten kann.

 Dein Ansprechpartner

Moritz Erlbeck

People Growth & Hiring Lead

85609 Aschheim

jobs.title: Technical Product Lead - AI Finance
jobs.description:
About BJAK 
 The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
  
 The Role 
 BJAK is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
  
 These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
  
 The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
  
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
  

 What We're Looking For 
 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
  

 Nice to have 
 Engineering or highly technical product background.

 Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
  

 Outcome 
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
  

 Location 
 This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 
  
 Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
  
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
  
 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 Online assessment or practical task

 Technical interview

 CEO / final round

  
 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Core Experience
jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. 
 n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.
 
 Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:
 
 Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation

 
That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register .
 
 We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.
 
 Your main goal will be to make building with n8n feel simple, powerful, and intuitive at every level, helping first-time users get to value quickly while enabling experienced builders to confidently create and run sophisticated workflows in production.
 
 To do so, you’ll own high-impact product areas across n8n’s Experience: from identifying the biggest builder problems to shaping strategy, shipping solutions, and continuously improving them based on real usage:
 
 Make the core building experience exceptional
 Identify and solve the highest-leverage problems across the workflow-building journey, making n8n easier to understand, faster to use, and more powerful as workflows grow in complexity.

 Turn technically complex capabilities into polished, intuitive product experiences through close collaboration with Design and Engineering.

 Continuously improve how users create, configure, debug, and evolve workflows, with a high bar for usability, performance, and reliability.

 
 Reduce friction from first workflow to production
 Find opportunities to dramatically shorten the path from an idea to a working workflow, particularly around setup, configuration, connectivity, and access to external services.

 Shape experiences that make capabilities such as AI models, web search, integrations, and other services immediately useful while handling underlying complexity elegantly.

 Balance simplicity with transparency and control so streamlined experiences continue to work for advanced, business-critical, and production use cases.

 
 Shape the foundations of a powerful builder platform
 Define product experiences and platform capabilities that make n8n flexible and extensible without exposing unnecessary complexity to users.

 Improve how builders interact with integrations, data, credentials, schemas, reusable capabilities, and emerging standards such as MCP.

 Partner with Engineering and developer-facing teams to ensure the product scales across an expanding ecosystem of services, use cases, and technical users.

 
 Drive product outcomes through discovery, data, and leadership
 Engage deeply with customers, community members, and internal teams to understand real workflows, pain points, and opportunities across the builder experience.

 Define clear product bets, success metrics, and priorities, combining quantitative evidence with strong product judgment and fast learning loops.

 Lead cross-functional teams across Engineering, Design, Data, DevRel, Docs, PMM, Support, and Customer Success through clear decisions, strong communication, and ownership of outcomes.

 
 REQUIREMENTS
 
 Must-haves 
 Proven product management experience: You’ve shipped impactful software products in fast-moving environments and can clearly explain the outcomes, decisions, and tradeoffs you owned.

 Builder mindset: You’re entrepreneurial and hands-on, and you enjoy moving from an ambiguous problem to a prototype, shipped product, and iteration quickly.

 Excellent product & UX judgment: You’re known for simplifying complexity and have a strong instinct for what makes technical products intuitive, polished, and enjoyable to use.

 Technical fluency: You’re comfortable reasoning about APIs, integrations, authentication, schemas, data flows, and system constraints and can partner deeply with engineers.

 Strong product discovery skills: You get close to users, uncover the underlying problem behind feature requests, validate assumptions, and turn insights into focused product decisions.

 Data fluency: You can define meaningful success metrics, investigate product behaviour and funnels, and combine quantitative evidence with qualitative insight and product intuition

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
THE LAST FRONTIER 
 The Arctic is a place of extremes: unforgiving, untamed, and undergoing rapid change. A literal defrosting reveals a multi-trillion-dollar opportunity spanning energy, defence, logistics, research, and infrastructure.
 
 ARD was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox - an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence - is why we exist. Our solution is autonomy.
 
 We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to.
 
 Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk.
 
 ABOUT THE ROLE 
Our engineering team is expanding rapidly, and we’re looking for a Technical Project Manager to sit at the heart of it, driving delivery across our engineering portfolio. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on ambiguity, moves fast, and can bring order to multiple complex, multi-disciplinary hardware projects without slowing them down.
 
 You'll be responsible for planning, tracking, and de-risking delivery across products at varying stages of maturity - from early-TRL prototypes through to fielded, mission-ready systems - and from field-ready energy systems to autonomous surface and sub-surface platforms.

 WHAT YOU’LL DO 
 Own project planning and delivery tracking across concurrent engineering projects and work streams (firmware, electronics, mechanical, testing), translating product strategy and portfolio priorities into executable projects with clear milestones, owners, and outcomes.

 Convert ambitious commercial and operational deadlines into realistic, resourced delivery plans — holding the line on both ambition and delivery discipline.

 Maintain visibility across work streams, dependencies, risks, decisions, and resourcing gaps, managing technical risk and dependency mapping across products at different Technology Readiness Levels (TRL) and adjusting project rigour and testing requirements accordingly.

 Take ownership of BOMs for any existing and future products, manage key supplier relationships and keep track of all materials deliveries.

 Technical Expertise: Understand the architecture, dependencies, and technical challenges of hardware design and development. Support engineering teams in resolving technical issues. Ensure compliance with industry standards and government regulations, such as MIL-STD, UK DEFSTAN, and STANAG testing and qualification requirements across the product lifecycle.

 Act as the connective tissue across engineering, procurement, business development, security, product, commercial, and customers — driving cross-functional alignment and ensuring technical progress, customer commitments, and delivery constraints are understood on all sides.

 Identify and resolve blockers fast, escalate early and clearly, and provide concise, decision-ready updates on consequential tradeoffs.

 Build and refine the project management tooling, processes, and reporting cadence as ARD scales — you'll be creating much of this from scratch.

 Identify missing handoffs and unwritten work, converting them into accountable plans, and facilitate requirements and scope definition with product, customer, and technical owners.

 Lead pilots, implementations, migrations, rollouts, adoption, and operational handoffs.

 
 WHAT YOU’LL BRING 
 Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Computer, Aerospace, Mechanical Engineering, or adjacent discipline - or - experience working in a technical engineering role prior to working as a project manager.

 4+ years proven experience in Technical Engineering Project Management across multiple concurrent projects,, delivering complex hardware products, ideally in defence, aerospace, or another regulated hardware environment; and ideally at a range of company maturity stages.

 Working familiarity with MIL-STD testing standards, UK DEFSTAN, and NATO STANAG requirements, and how these shape project planning and qualification timelines.

 Comfort operating across a range of TRL levels — from early, rapid prototyping and experimentation through to production-grade delivery — and judgement on how to flex process accordingly.

 A genuine start-up mentality: comfortable with ambiguity, resourcefulness, and getting hands dirty where needed, rather than waiting for the perfect process.

 A track record of hitting ambitious deadlines in fast-moving, resource-constrained environments.

 Strong stakeholder management skills — able to communicate technical risk and progress clearly to both engineers and non-technical leadership.
